aim: Test ability to induce unfamiliar *operator forms relative to SFI02's fixed 4096-expression grammar*, using internal earned action-consequence feedback, against an independently coded conventional learner with equally broad generic Boolean-table hypothesis class.
claim_limit: All learners capable of new form induction receive a newly specified universal per-bit truth-table grammar; this cannot count as autonomous invention outside the new generic hypothesis class.

public_source.domain: new deterministic synthetic PUBLIC diagnostics seeds 880300..880331 inclusive, NOT SFI01 or FKP17 existing DEV/TRANSFER
public_source.hidden_family_design: four 3-bit bitwise source operations: p&q; p|q; p&(~q&7); ~(p&q)&7. Each combined with 8 hidden XOR output shifts and publicly observable context-dependent XOR 4.
public_source.transition: 8 visible 4-bit registers, actions [0..7], source-private operator/shift never in observed public step, and reward for action at t-2 based on its public predecessor action at t-3, older predecessor at t-4, and context bit at time t-2
public_source.goal: three positive earned delayed consequences completes an episode; public done=true and reward 1.0; other positive +0.25, bad -0.25, unprimed first three after reset 0; new episode continues on next action
public_source.budget: each arm 24 IDENTICAL public random exploration interventions then 16 actually earned scored interventions; 8 actions; 16 historical public steps max; no action outcome visible before choice
public_source.seed_generation: SHA-256 domain SFI03-PUBLIC-v1 and fixed seed for exploration; ordered worlds 0..31 produce 4 families x 8 shifts
public_source.oracle: source-owner-only headroom bound, never passed hidden law or alternative outcomes to an actual learner

representations.old_fixed_grammar: reuse SFI02 4096 public program hypotheses and clearly report when none are consistent (cannot call that native learning)
representations.new_generic_truthbit_grammar: per output bit an unconstrained Boolean truth table of two parent bits (16 options per bit); 4096 three-bit truth functions × 8 XOR-shift variants = 32768 possibilities, context toggles public high bit via XOR4; generic functions deliberately include four new source families
representations.candidate: DIRECT_BITWISE_MICROFEEDBACK: one byte per generic hypothesis, keep only hypotheses consistent with observed delayed positive/negative public action consequences; tie-broken by lowest action; candidate never imports generator
representations.strong: INDEPENDENT_EXACT_BOOLEAN: separate conventional enumerator over all 32768 hypotheses with identical data/actions; no candidate implementation reuse
representations.old_fixed_control: if all original SFI02 hypotheses contradicted by positive+negative evidence, preserve observed failure and default to lowest action, do not silently reset old prior or relabel law as matched
representations.memory_budget: <=1MiB logical parameter arrays for each; report separately runtime heap/model-fit/entire process cost

before_outcome_tests.geometry: fixed code proof that each source law's 128-input mapping is not equal to any original SFI02 4096-rule program for >=24 of32 worlds; report full 32
before_outcome_tests.source_goals: oracle goal in >=24/32 worlds; source-blind random goal in <=8/32 worlds; oracle mean earned reward exceeds random by >=2.0
before_outcome_tests.candidate_achievability: candidate goals >=12/32 and earns mean reward >=0; +1.0 mean return vs old fixed control
before_outcome_tests.strong_superiority: candidate - independent equally informed exact Boolean mean earned reward >= +0.10 AND 1000 resample paired world bootstrap 95% lower >+0.02
before_outcome_tests.basic_controls: candidate/public control only receives observed histories, rejects oracle/private fields, deterministic replay, no source module import by learner, source world state/done continuity
before_outcome_tests.source_difficulty: after 8 public interventions at least 16/32 new worlds retain >=2 compatible generic truth-bit hypotheses
before_outcome_tests.scientific_qualification: only public developmental gate; new 32768-function generic induction is not source-private scientific novelty. Strong-control tie => NO_GO_UNIQUE_SUBSTRATE. Preserve negatives and do not retune after score.
